title: Detail Description · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Detail Description · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Place an ordinary object where everyone can see it. The lead names three visible details without touching or moving the object. The group confirms all three details are visible. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: One household object.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Detail Description, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group confirms all three details are visible.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group confirms all three details are visible.
